subject: Request: data-access credits for archival NLP pilot
messages:
From: Dr. Alana Reyes <alana.reyes@legacyinst.edu>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marta.lin@legacyinst.edu
Date: 2027-10-03T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Pilot credits for archival OCR/NLP project

Hi Jonas,

I lead the Digital Collections group at the Legacy Institute for Historical Preservation. We are preparing a small pilot to run OCR-cleanup and named-entity extraction over 2.5M scanned pages (historic newspapers, 1850-1950) and want to evaluate Redwood for inference + embedding workflows. Our team is academic (non-profit), and budget is tight — would Redwood consider a pilot allocation of compute/credits for evaluation?

High-level:
- Goal: assess entity extraction quality and chunking strategy for downstream search
- Expected usage: ~25k pages cleaned / month, variable token rates as we experiment
- Timeline: Nov 2027 -> Feb 2028 (3-4 month pilot)

I've attached a short SOW and a small sample dataset (zipped) for scope. Procurement will need an estimate of credits to generate an internal PO if we proceed. Can you advise what a reasonable promo/top-up would look like and next steps?

Best,
Alana Reyes
Director, Digital Collections
Legacy Institute for Historical Preservation
(555) 415-0921

Attachments: legacyinst_sow_sample_dataset.zip
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Dr. Alana Reyes <alana.reyes@legacyinst.edu>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, marta.lin@legacyinst.edu
Date: 2027-10-03T12:00:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits for archival OCR/NLP project

Hi Alana — thanks for the SOW and sample, this looks like an excellent fit for a research pilot. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can scope the promo:

- Do you expect long sequences after OCR (e.g., full-article text) or will you chunk at paragraph/line level?
- Rough tokens per page estimate (OCR raw) if you have one — helps size the initial grant
- Any regulatory or data residency constraints (US-only ok?)

Initial offer (subject to internal approval): we can provision an evaluation credit pool and a short-term dedicated throughput window to avoid throttling during the ingest phase. Typical promo we give for similar pilots is in the 30k–100k token-equivalent range depending on expected volume and duration; for a 3-month exploratory pilot I'd propose starting with 50k tokens and monitor usage + quality.

I'll loop in Marissa (account lead) for approval and Ben (sales ops) for the PO/credit flow. If you can send a draft PO or procurement contact, that speeds the legal/billing step.

Next steps:
1) You answer the 3 Qs above or send an expected tokens estimate
2) We provision a temporary credit pool and schedule a short onboarding call (30m)
3) Procurement finalizes PO or DocuSign for formal approval

Thanks — I can host the onboarding call next week (Tue/Wed afternoon ET).

— Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Dr. Alana Reyes <alana.reyes@legacyinst.edu>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement <procurement@legacyinst.edu>, marta.lin@legacyinst.edu
Date: 2027-10-04T08:41:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits for archival OCR/NLP project

Thanks Jonas — quick answers below and attached a one-page procurement contact note.

- Chunking strategy: we will try paragraph-level chunking for entity extraction, with a fallback to line-level on poor OCR pages.
- Rough tokens/page: after cleanup we estimate 800–1,200 tokens per page (varies). For 25k pages/month that is ~20M–30M tokens/month, but only a subset will be processed in full until we optimize.
- Residency: US-only for this project.

Procurement contact: procurement@legacyinst.edu (PO workflow typically 4–6 weeks). Marta (cc) is the project manager.

We have included SOW and a small sample dataset in the attached ZIP (2k pages). Let us know if you want a short call to walk through the sample.

Best,
Alana

Attachments: pilot_scope_estimates.xlsx, legacyinst_sow_sample_dataset.zip
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-04T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot credits for archival OCR/NLP project — ask for approval

Ben/Priyom — forwarding Alana's details; this is a non-profit research pilot (Legacy Institute) with conservative commercial upside but high reference value for gov/heritage vertical. Jonas proposes 50k tokens to start, but their rough math suggests higher nominal consumption if they actually process tens of thousands of pages.

Proposal for approval:
- Provision an initial promo credit of 50k tokens to get the experiments underway and a dedicated ingest window for 2 weeks to avoid cold throttling.
- If they hit 60–70% of that within two weeks, we can auto-top up an additional 50k (contingent on a short check-in and quality signal).
- For procurement: we will accept a simple PO referencing RDW-2027-0198. Legal only needs a minimal SOW addendum and standard MSA terms.

Why approve: good non-profit reference, dataset type (archival) is one our engineering team is keen to test quantization/batch improvements on, and the project could produce public write-ups.

Please reply all with approval or questions.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: Dr. Alana Reyes <alana.reyes@legacyinst.edu>, procurement <procurement@legacyinst.edu>
Date: 2027-10-04T15:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits for archival OCR/NLP project — approved

All — approved. I sign off on the initial 50k credit pool with the automatic one-time top-up trigger if they consume >60% in the first two weeks. Please note the following operations items:

- Jon as AE: schedule the onboarding call and capture their expected weekly token burn in HubSpot.
- Marissa as AM: add the PO template to the thread and liaise with procurement for a simple PO referencing RDW-2027-0198.
- Priyom as SE: prepare an ingest throughput window and quota config for the first two weeks to avoid throttling and collect latency metrics.

I'll ask Sales Ops to issue the promo credits once the onboarding slot is scheduled. I also uploaded the DocuSign envelope for a simple SOW addendum (link below).

Next actions:
1) Jonas: book the 30m onboarding (Tue/Wed next week) and send calendar invite to Alana/Marta.
2) Marissa: forward PO template / cost estimate to procurement@legacyinst.edu.
3) Priyom: prepare a small runbook for ingest and quota config.

Thanks — Ben
VP, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
